heard: A Soviet probe survived hell and whispered secrets from another world. In August 1970, Venera 7 launched to conquer the most hostile environment in the solar system. Engineers built its heavy titanium hull to withstand 180 atmospheres of crushing pressure. During descent, the parachute failed and plunged the robotic lander into a severe freefall. It slammed into the dark side of Venus on December 15, 1970 and abruptly went silent. Weeks later, astronomers found a faint signal buried deep within the background noise. Landing on its side pointed the antenna away, hiding 23 precious minutes of history. That incredible hidden transmission proved our Soviet probe survived hell.
